spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (इष्यति)
To go.
r. 6th cl. (इच्छति)
1 To wish, to desire.
2 To accept, to receive.
With अभि,
to desire:
with प्रति,
to engage, to promise.
r. 9th cl. (इष्णाति)
To repeat an act, to do any thing again and again.
With अनु prefixed,
to search after, to investigate or enquire.

m. (-षः)
The month Āśvina, (September-October.)
E.
इष to go, क affix; also ईष.

r. 2nd cl. (ङ) ईशङ् (ईष्टे)
To possess power, property, or authority.

m. (-शः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

Also of the same deity as regent of the north-east quarter.
3 A ruler, a master.
f. (-शा)
The shaft of a plough.
E.
ईश to rule, क aff.

r. 1st cl. (ङ) ईषङ (ईषते)
1 To go or move.
2 To kill or hurt.
3 To see.
4 To give.
(उ.) ईषु (ईषति)
To glean.

m. (-षः)
The month Aśvin: see इष.

f. (-षा)
The pole or shaft of a plough.
E.
ईष to go, affixes क and टाप्; also ईशा.

m. (-खा)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
ईश ŚIVA, and सखि a friend.

m. (-न्तः)
1 An elephant with large tusks.
2 The tusk of an elephant.
E.
ईशा and दन्त a tooth; whose tooth is of the size of a plough-shaft, or the tooth which is so.

m. (-न्तः)
An elephant with a large tusk or tooth.
E.
ईषा and दन्त a tooth: see ईशादन्त.

m. (-नः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

Also of the same as regent of the north-east quarter.
3 One of the

Rudras.
4

The sun as a form of ŚIVA.
mf. (-नः-नी)
The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum).
n. (-नं)
Light, splendor.
f. (-नी)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
ईश a master, &c. and आनच् affix, and fem. ङीष्

n. (-लं)
Shallow water, a little water.
E.
ईषत् and जल water.

ind.
A little.
E.
ईष to go, अत् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Diminutive, delicate.
2 Doing little.
3 What little is done to or made of.
E.
ईषत् a little, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
What is little drank or drank little of.
E.
ईषत् and पान drink.

mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
What is little gained of.
E.
इषत् and प्रलम्भ profit.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Tepid, slightly warm.
E.
ईषत् and उष्ण warm.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Of little merit.
E.
ईषत् and गुण quality.

m. (-ण्डुः)
A pale or light brown colour.
E.
ईषत् a little, and पाण्डु pale.

m. (-षः)
A mean man.
E.
ईषत् and पुरुष a man.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Not quite complete or entire.
E.
ईषत् and ऊन less.

n. (-नं)
A glance at, a slight inspection.
E.
ईषत् and दर्शन seeing.

m. (-सः)
A smile.
E.
ईषत् a little, and हास laughter.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Of a pale red (colour.)
E.
ईषत् and रक्त red.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Exchanged for a little.
E.
ईषत् and निमय barter.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
What little is or can be gained of.
E.
ईषत् and लभ what gets.

m. (-ण्डः)
The handle of a plough.
E.
ईषा the staff, and दण्ड a stick.
